metadata.placement: native block_ring_hash, fixed within topology across all strategies
metadata.sampling_caveat: raw data values; profile weights and arrival trace are constructed, not observed production frequencies
metadata.near_topology_comparison_caveat: not a near retuning: identical profile quotas, arrivals and original NPU bindings across topologies; only SSD placement changes
metadata.reference_regime: previous fixed 6-SSU same_trace quota, five replacements

arrival_workload.rate_definition: all 8-layer bytes of requests arriving after t=0 / last arrival time; t=0 backlog excluded
arrival_workload.retiming_rule: sort reference positive arrivals by (arrival_ms, request_id); arrival_ms = 1000*cumulative_8layer_bytes/(2**30*target_gib_s)
arrival_workload.finite_window_caveat: discrete request-work arrivals, not constant instantaneous SSD traffic or a per-window completion requirement

cir_policy: shared FINAL_STATIC; no runtime CIR changes

slo.window_cohort_caveat: admission cohorts can differ across policies; all_requests is the matched complete population

adapter_statistics.global_client_ledger: all managed IO: planned/unissued + sent/unacked at HBM

global_client.counter_source: actual client sends minus HBM ACKs; not SSD queue reads

global_coflow.progress_source: activated layer counts minus client HBM ACKs

backend_arbitration.scope: cross-Path choice only within native min-finish+EPS equivalence set

summary.batch_compute_calibration: singleton layer times added; no batch speedup
summary.bandwidth_unit_assumption: configured numeric rates applied directly; no GiB-to-GB conversion
